name: agripilot-ai
description: AgriPilot AI — AI Decision Support System for Modern Farmers

scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,emerald" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan,emerald" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:push && npm --prefix backend run prisma:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
